ItemID: NA; Title: Il Volo; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Vocal harmonies and classical crossover fit my interest in Il Divo and musical-theatre recordings.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Polished vocal duets appeal to the same listening mood as Stages and A Musical Affair.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Vocal Christmas music fits my collection, but I would choose something less seasonal this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Legend: The Best of Willie Nelson; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed some country music, but traditional country is less appealing than orchestral vocals right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Moody Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in vocal ensembles and relaxing classical music than an Elvis album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Guardians of the Galaxy; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A pop-rock soundtrack does not closely match my current interest in classical and theatrical vocals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Christmas With Scotty McCreery; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The country Christmas combination is less compelling to me than the choral and orchestral recordings I have chosen before.
ItemID: NA; Title: Voyage II; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Celtic Thunder's ensemble vocals fit my interest in Under One Sky and Lead With Your Heart.
ItemID: NA; Title: I Dreamed A Dream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expressive singing and familiar theatrical material fit what I enjoy about Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: Clear As Day; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in 747 and Golden does not make this country album a strong enough match to choose today.
